title: Pan-Fried British Fritters with Golden Oceanic Sauce
description: Crispy British fritters served with a golden oceanic sauce, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, mix fritters mix, eggs, and a pinch of salt.
2. Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
3. Form fritters into small patties and coat with bread crumbs.
4. Fry fritters until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
6. In a separate pan, heat golden oceanic sauce over low heat.
7. Serve fritters with golden oceanic sauce.
8. Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
